name: ALLY 28 – Mail-Assistent
description: Unterablauf der neuen Oberfläche (BA5): Mail-Assistent – Überblick, Antwortvorschläge, Neue Mail, Finden, Mail-Log. Liefert nur JSON.

parameters.query:
SELECT s.person IS NOT NULL AS ok,
  CASE WHEN s.person IS NOT NULL THEN arbeit_web_seite($1::text, 'mails', '{}'::jsonb) END AS v,
  CASE WHEN s.person IS NOT NULL AND $2::text <> '' THEN arbeit_web_seite($1::text, 'mails', jsonb_build_object('suche', '1', 'q', $2::text, 'tage', $3::text)) END AS f,
  CASE WHEN s.person IS NOT NULL THEN arbeit_web_seite($1::text, 'mails', jsonb_build_object('log', '1', 'q', $4::text, 'tage', $5::text, 'kategorie', $6::text)) END AS l,
  CASE WHEN s.person IS NOT NULL THEN arbeit_web_seite($1::text, 'mails', jsonb_build_object('log', '1', 'tage', '1', 'kategorie', 'kunde')) END AS l24,
  CASE WHEN s.person IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('adresse', p.adresse, 'aktiv', p.aktiv, 'eingerichtet', coalesce(pp.eingerichtet, false),
      'ergebnis', pp.pruef_ergebnis, 'geprueft', to_char(pp.letzte_pruefung AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM.YYYY, HH24:MI')) ORDER BY p.adresse), '[]'::jsonb)
    FROM ally_postfaecher p LEFT JOIN postfach_plaetze pp ON pp.adresse = p.adresse WHERE ally_postfach_zustaendig(s.person, p.adresse)) END AS pf,
  CASE WHEN s.person IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(z.schluessel, z.wert), '{}'::jsonb) FROM ally_ui_zustand z
    WHERE z.person = s.person AND split_part(z.schluessel, '.', 1) = 'mail-assistent') END AS zustand
FROM (SELECT 1) x LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM ally_ui_sitzung($1::text) y WHERE NOT y.muss_pw_setzen) s ON true;
